free_tier.stated: No published per-file or total quota. Known caps: project media and gallery images limited to 2 MB. Mod file upload limit is not documented in public terms.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Free, Cloudflare-fronted (edge.forgecdn.net / mediafilez.forgecdn.net), no auth on downloads.

tooling: Documented Upload API: POST /api/projects/{projectId}/upload-file with multipart `metadata` + `file`, X-Api-Token header; also Maven for some project types. Third-party wrapper: github.com/itsmeow/curseforge-upload. No rclone.
chaining: Unlimited projects per author account (no documented cap) x unknown per-file size. If the effective cap resembles Modrinth's 500 MiB, 1000 projects = ~500 GB.
limits_note: Every project and every file goes through human moderation before release; media 2 MB; project metadata must be in English and must plausibly describe a mod. Upload limit per file is unverified.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Manual moderation queue means automated bulk uploads get rejected or the author account locked; releases can be delisted retroactively.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
